title: verify: re-measure harness.required-providers.test.ts's test-budget header on the 10 s grid
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37700 (PR #37708, seat record 7204570619, ACCEPT 7204584166; os-dev report 7204490728 out-of-scope finding), filed by the owning zone ai-37000 under #37700 at the seat's direction, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · domain:server · Task · p3 (seat-directed) · reach: packages/verify test budget · evidence: CI run 45888214247 job 140145134703.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：验证测试文件头上记的耗时预算（28 秒）过期了，也不在规定的 10 秒刻度上；按实测改正。
- 谁受益：测试耗时预算检查能正确提醒慢测试。
- 不做会怎样：预算数字失真，慢测试可能漏报；功能不受影响。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

`packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts` carries `test-budget: 28`, set by PR #37442. `readTestBudget` requires a value on the 10 s grid, and the full run 45888214247 took the file at 57.8 s (about 70 on the grid). The header's own text says the first CI reading after the knowledge boots re-measures it.

## Acceptance

- After PR #37708 lands, the header is re-set from a CI reading of the file, on the 10 s grid, with the reading named in the commit or PR.
- The test-budget gate reads the new value without complaint.
